persoenlichkeit.v: He treats every save as a personal misunderstanding.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He treats every save as a personal misunderstanding. In HyperNorm he guards the laundry-room doorway and accepts only safe or unsafe deliveries. The keeper gloves are oversized because doubt tends to arrive in pairs; he lets children retrieve lost socks without checking their score. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er hält den Kasten sauber. Die Akten über die Gegentore sind verschwunden.

persoenlichkeit.v: She celebrates the attack before anyone has agreed where the goal is.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: She celebrates the attack before anyone has agreed where the goal is. Her building league divides residents into winners and obstructions. She keeps the old leather ball for its reliable seams, but has secretly been passing to the supposedly useless neighbours; their surprised faces are her favourite celebration. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie spielt nach vorn. Die Richtung wird nach dem Spiel beschlossen.

persoenlichkeit.v: He regards any change of direction as an attack on tradition.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He regards any change of direction as an attack on tradition. He considers the courtyard an area that must be defended from new ideas. The battered shin guard is his portable boundary marker. A dissonant card suggesting that moving aside could help the team has become extremely difficult to tackle. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er verteidigt den Bestand. Auch gegen die eigene Mannschaft.

persoenlichkeit.v: She can see every passing option except the one involving herself.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: She can see every passing option except the one involving herself. Her three circles once represented the only acceptable social positions: useful, waiting and in the way. After a stranger passed her a dissonant card, she began moving the circles until everyone had someone nearby. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie verteilt das Spiel. Sich selbst hat sie auf dem Zettel vergessen.

persoenlichkeit.v: He is quick enough to outrun the plan and slow enough to explain why.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He is quick enough to outrun the plan and slow enough to explain why. He delivers approved announcements along the corridors and believes a plan is either fast or disloyal. The lucky boot contains no foot and, increasingly, no evidence that speed is a moral quality. He still carries messages for slow neighbours. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Schuh bringt Glück. Laufen muss weiterhin jemand anders.

persoenlichkeit.v: He keeps adding injury time to conversations nobody wants to finish.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He keeps adding injury time to conversations nobody wants to finish. He times corridor meetings with a brass stopwatch and classifies every resident as ready or delaying the team. One dissonant card asked whether a pause could be part of play. He has not stopped thinking about it, officially. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Nachspielzeit dauert an. Es wurden weitere Wortmeldungen verletzt.
